cases.answer: China produced about a third of the world's carbon dioxide emissions in 2025, which shows its industrial growth has come at a large environmental cost.
China joined the World Trade Organization in 2001, which opened export markets to its manufacturers and supported economic growth.
China's World Bank Gini coefficient was 36.0 in 2022.
China's HDI rose from 0.404 in 1990 to 0.622 in 2023.
China's World Bank Gini coefficient fell from 36.0 in 1990 to 32.2 in 2022, so income inequality fell.
Nepal's remittances rose from 1.5% of GDP in 1993 to 32.3% of GDP in 2025. That is an increase from 1.5% to 32.3%.
